decision.description: A human-written `pass` additionally requires a consumed gate_accept approval whose content_hash = computeGateContentHash(gate) (the hash excludes approval_digest); missing approval is E_GATE_NO_APPROVAL. A stored pass is immutable except through `gate revoke`: authored `pending`/`fail`/`revoked` over a stored pass is E_GATE_HUMAN_ONLY ('use gate revoke'), and `pass` -> `pass` with changed content requires a fresh gate_accept approval for the new content (digest restamped). The model gate_upsert path cannot write pass or revoked, and cannot modify a stored pass gate (E_GATE_HUMAN_ONLY). `revoked` is written only by the human `gate revoke --id <G> --approver <email>` transition, which requires a stored pass gate and canonical approver != owner, demotes every accepted decision citing the gate to proposed/needs_review with artifacts ready=false before writing, and journals gate_revoke. gate create with revoked is E_GATE_HUMAN_ONLY.

approver.description: Stored verbatim; empty/leading/trailing whitespace is E_SCHEMA. Comparisons use canonicalIdentity: NFKC + trim; email domain lowercased (local-part case preserved), other ids whole-lowercase; empty rejected.

owner.description: Stored verbatim; empty/leading/trailing whitespace is E_SCHEMA. Comparisons use canonicalIdentity: NFKC + trim; email domain lowercased (local-part case preserved), other ids whole-lowercase; empty rejected.
Stored verbatim; empty or leading/trailing whitespace is E_SCHEMA. Identity comparisons use canonicalIdentity.

approval_digest.description: System-derived provenance, never authored: `gate create --approval` stamps the 64-hex digest of the consumed gate_accept approval. Decision acceptance requires a stored pass gate whose approval_digest resolves to a used granted gate_accept record with target = gate_id, approver = gate.approver, and content_hash = computeGateContentHash(stored gate minus approval_digest). Missing/unresolvable/unused/mismatched provenance is E_GATE_BLOCKED. A submitted gate JSON containing this field is rejected with E_SCHEMA.
